div.i: Every method is fitted to February 2024 through September 2026 and compared with the actual fourth quarter: Trend with FORECAST.LINEAR, Mean as the average of the fitted months. Quarter error is the quarter's forecast against its actual, positive when the forecast is too high; Monthly MAPE is the mean absolute percentage error of the three months. Outlined: the errors.
